rules: Use bold or heavy weights for headings to create a playful and engaging feel.
Never use Inter or generic sans for headings.
Maintain tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) for large text (Size > 32px).
Ensure hierarchy jump between heading and subheading does not exceed 2 Tailwind steps.
Use the VIBRANT PLAY archetype (Youth Coaching) with bright, friendly colors.
Ensure high contrast for text against all colored backgrounds.
Never use pure #000000 or #808080. Tint neutrals with blue or orange.
Do NOT use teal green or teal blue (#1B93A4) for dashboards.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use backdrop-blur-xl (or 2xl) and semi-transparent backgrounds for floating navigation and overlays. Must include a delicate 1px inner stroke.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Use soft, diffuse ambient shadows to create a tactile, touchable feel (e.g., shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.12)]).
visual_enhancers.borders: Apply generous rounded corners everywhere (e.g., rounded-2xl or rounded-3xl). Avoid sharp edges entirely.
visual_enhancers.gradients: Use smooth, vibrant gradients sparingly for hero sections and gamified elements, but avoid full-screen generic gradients.

layouts.marketing: Use Bento grids for the landing page with wide gaps (gap-8 to gap-12). Prioritize asymmetry and breathing room.
layouts.dashboard: Use a high-density but playful grid for the Parent Dashboard. Ensure full-height alignment on children. Avoid jagged bottoms.
layouts.spacing: Use 2-3x more spacing than typical designs (p-6, p-8, p-12). Containers with borders must have internal padding.
rules: Grid items MUST be direct children of grid containers.
Optical alignment is prioritized over geometrical alignment (e.g., round icons next to text).
Integrate Framer Motion for micro-interactions: bouncing buttons, hover lifts (-translate-y-1), and staggered list entrances.
Implement Lottie animations for rewards like confetti drops and animated brain characters.
Do NOT apply universal transitions (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific properties to prevent breaking transforms.
Normal text must meet 4.5:1 contrast ratio, large text 3:1.
Do NOT use completely transparent backgrounds for headers, overlays, or dropdowns. Always use a solid or glassmorphism background.
All interactive elements MUST explicitly set text color on hover and have high-contrast focus states.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

component_instructions.buttons: Design big, tactile, pill-shaped buttons with strong visual depth and clear press states (Duolingo-style).
component_instructions.cards: Use rounded corners with soft UI components, engaging icons, and playful, vibrant accents.
component_instructions.progress_bars: Integrate visible progress tracking (bars, rings) with bright colors and milestones to sustain motivation.
component_instructions.forms_and_inputs: Use heavily customized Shadcn components (Input, Select) rather than native HTML tags. Avoid the 'default Vercel' look.
component_instructions.toast: Use sonner for toast notifications and style them playfully.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Prioritize building for .js files since the environment is JavaScript, not TypeScript (.tsx).
Do NOT use HTML-based components for advanced user interactions (e.g., use Shadcn for dropdowns, calendars, and dialogs).
Avoid generic 'AI slop' aesthetics. Do not use simplistic gradients or uniform styling. Create depth through layered design elements.
Never center align the root app container (do not add .App { text-align: center; } in CSS). Left-align dense content.
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯) for icons. Use lucide-react or Phosphor Icons.
Include data-testid on every interactive element (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button').
If the content scrolls under the header, use Crystal Glass style; if it cuts off, use a Solid Background.
